item.title: Legacy Project discusses protecting historic assets during talk session
item.description: A community gathering on Dorr Street’s future turned emotional as neighbors described, in vivid detail, the businesses, schools, and gathering places they watched disappear.

item.title: Big Ten women's basketball tournament: UCLA chasing bigger dreams
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS — No. 2 UCLA has spent the past year celebrating one net-cutting ceremony after another.

item.title: Anxious travelers scramble as Iran war strands tens of thousands across the Middle East
item.description: Frustrated and anxious travelers searched Tuesday for any way out of the Middle East and beyond as the widening Iran war choked off commercial air traffic through the region for a fourth straight day, stranding tens of thousands of people.

item.title: Man indicted in theft; victim indicted in suspect’s shooting
item.description: A Toledo man has been indicted on multiple felonies after he chased down and shot the man who allegedly stole his truck in February.

item.title: Caninballz dog water park temporarily closes after all employees quit
item.description: After five months in business, Caninballz indoor dog water park has put a “paws” in its operations, temporarily closing, according to a flyer on its door.

item.title: Toledo City Council votes down lease agreement near retirees golf course
item.description: About 30 people packed the first four rows of seats at Toledo City Council on Tuesday wearing green to show their support for keeping Toledo’s parks green.

item.title: University of Toledo launches cancer research institute
item.description: University of Toledo leaders Tuesday announced the official launch of a cancer research institute they described as an interdepartmental effort to shorten the path from medical discovery to patient treatment.

item.title: Jalen Tyson, James Harden lead Cavs past Pistons 113-109
item.description: CLEVELAND — Jaylon Tyson scored 22 points, James Harden added 18 and the Cleveland Cavaliers avenged a recent loss in Detroit by beating the East-leading Pistons 113-109 on Tuesday night despite playing without injured star Donovan Mitchell.

item.title: High school basketball: Genoa boys upend Liberty-Benton in district semifinal
item.description: KANSAS, Ohio — Top-seeded Genoa took control in the second and third quarters to defeat Liberty-Benton 65-48 in a Division V, Northwest 1 district boys basketball semifinal Tuesday at Lakota High School.
